summary: Determined the n=6 three-minus structure. KEY RESULT: the three-minus amplitude has NO factorization poles - every channel D_S = omega_S^2/|k_S| - g = 0 is a spurious/removable singularity (A_6 stays finite, A_6*D_S -> 0), verified at n=5,6,7 across all channel types. Hence A_6 is PIECEWISE-POLYNOMIAL, not rational (resolves the PI's round-1 gate question). A_6 is purely imaginary, homogeneous degree 8, and symmetric under S_3 (minus legs) x S_3 (plus legs) x Z_2 (triple swap). Chamber walls are the mixed momentum subset walls k_S = sum sigma_i omega_i^2 = 0, where |k_S| flips and A_6 is continuous with a derivative kink. First ansatz: naive two-minus pair-sum candidates FAIL (structure genuinely new); identified the B-spline picture as the round-2 lead.
work_done: Built own copy of bg.cpp and a fast harness (harness.py) wrapping ./bg in on-shell and raw --amp modes, exact + double, reproducing the oracle's on-shell solve.

Wrote channels.py (factorization channel / propagator-denominator bookkeeping) and symbolic_bg.py (faithful sympy reimplementation of the full BG algorithm; reproduces ./bg exactly at n=5,6 numeric points).

TARGETED POLE SEARCH (targeted_pole.py, reachability.py): for every genuine size-3 channel type (2m1p {2,3,4},{2,3,5}; 1m2p {2,4,5},{3,4,5}; 3m0p {1,2,3}={4,5,6}) built one-parameter on-shell families driving a single D_S -> 0. A_6 stays FINITE in every case (A_6*D_S -> 0). Confirmed pole-free at n=5,6,7. Established three-minus is piecewise-polynomial, NOT rational.

CHAMBER WALLS (kinkmap.py, wallcheck.py): walls are the mixed-subset momentum walls k_S=0; A_6 is finite and continuous there (oracle SIGFPEs on |k_S|=0 but the limit exists) with a derivative kink. Confirmed at k_{24}=0, k_{34}=0 (first-derivative kink) and k_{234}=0 (cubic kink). D_S=0 channels are distinct and smooth.
Established A_6 structure: purely imaginary, degree-8 homogeneous, invariant under S_3 wr Z_2 (verify_threem.py, all exact).
FIRST ANSATZ (candidates.py): ruled out naive two-minus pair-sum forms (0/10 exact, non-constant ratios). Identified the B-spline / truncated-power identity as the structural lead for round 2.
Wrote consolidated reproducible check verify_threem.py (all checks pass, exact rational) and derivations/n6_structure.md.
next_steps: Round 2: extract the exact per-chamber cubic polynomial with symbolic_bg.py (freeze chamber signs from a reference point; D_S denominators cancel since pole-free) - no fitting needed.
Match the per-chamber cubics to a box-spline / B-spline of the omega_i^2 with breakpoints at the k_S=0 walls, then symmetrize under S_3 wr Z_2 to assemble the closed form for A_6.
Verify the assembled formula against ./bg at n=5,6,7 across chambers and wall limits; then attempt the general-n three-minus law.
